create_dataset_from_config: create a dataset subset from a config dictionary and split name using create_dataset
build_basesubclass_dataset: build a python subclass of BaseDataset that implements num_samples and __getitem__ for a custom OCP dataset format
filter_dataset_by_natoms: filter a dataset to only include samples with natoms less than or equal to a max_atoms threshold
sample_dataset_subset: sample a random subset of N samples from a dataset using the sample_n config option
get_metadata_for_indices: get metadata values for specific indices from a BaseDataset using the get_metadata method
